expo.name: Radiant
expo.description: Transform your mindset with daily gratitude, affirmations, and vision boards. Build streaks, track progress, and become the person you want to be.

infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Radiant needs access to your photo library to add images to your vision board.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Radiant needs access to your camera to take photos for your vision board.
infoPlist.NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription: Radiant sends daily reminders to help you maintain your gratitude practice and keep your streak alive.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Radiant needs speech recognition access to convert your spoken words into text for journal entries.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Radiant needs access to your microphone to transcribe your evening reflections using voice.

plugins.microphonePermission: Radiant needs access to your microphone to transcribe your evening reflections using voice.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Radiant needs speech recognition access to convert your spoken words into text.
